units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:5:7">Y. Sabb. II, 5ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>הבעיר וכיבה בנ׳ אחת</he> if he ignited and extinguished in one continued act of blowing.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14:8">Gen. R. s. 14</cite>, end <he>בעולם הזה בנ׳ וכ׳</he> in this world the breath of life is put in by blowing (<cite ref="Genesis 2:7">Gen. II, 7</cite>), … but in the coming world by placing (<cite ref="Ezekiel 37:6">Ez. XXXVII, 6</cite>).
<cite ref="Ezekiel 37:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ומה אם זה שעשוי בנְפִיחָתוֹ של בשר ודם וכ׳</he> if this (glass) which is produced by the blowing of a human being, can be restored (when broken) &c.; a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:7:4">Y. Meg. III, 74ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>בנ׳ אחת</he> in one breath (v. <cite ref="N01314"><he>נְשִׁימָה</he></cite>).—[<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:12">Ruth R. to III, 3</cite> <he>אזל נפיחה</he>, v. <cite ref="N01037"><he>נְפֵי</he></cite>.]
